linear_toy.continuous: d sigma/dt = -lambda_c sigma + k_c sigma + g: unstable iff k_c >= lambda_c (feedback gain >= leak rate); Euler step dt: lambda = lambda_c dt, lambda k = k_c dt  =>  k = k_c/lambda_c
